title: Week 1 of Shieldwall: Draugr Tide: from gray boxes to real assets
author: Imaginary-Tear4186
selftext:
Last week this tower defense game was a set of gray boxes: hexagons for towers, a brown box for my longship, tan blocks for the road. This week the first island, the longship and my hero Halvard are real 3D models in the running game.
    
    
    The game: a semi-idle 3D tower defense. You are a viking whose longship ran aground on a cursed beach. Every night the draugr walk up out of the surf. You build Norse towers along the road, fight in person as Halvard, and keep the dead away from the hull. A run is 30 waves across a growing archipelago.
    
    
    What got done in week 1:
    
    - 
    **A playable core loop, waves 1 to 10.**
     Three towers with four upgrade tiers, a hero with auto-guard, Wave Spoils card picks after every wave, four boss fights (Grave Troll, Bell Warden, Drowned Jarl, The Whisperer) and a second islet that rises after wave 5.
    - 
    **Balance before beauty.**
     The wave HP table is generated from a pressure curve, and autoplay bots play every build.
    - 
    **Assets from Tripo AI, cleaned in Blender.**
     The island is about 10k triangles. The longship went from 2.9 MB to 196 KB with Draco compression. Halvard has 7,082 triangles, 54 bones and 13 animation clips, matched frame by frame to an animation sheet.
    
    
    Honest status: towers, enemies and bosses are still gray boxes. That is next.
    
    Thank you
